payload_reference: raw T*K complex amplitudes per RX; ratios (T-1)*K complex amplitudes; actual quantization, packet overhead, beam timing and miss handling not tested
bgpc_scope: Same observed 3x4 response matrices and known transmit array weights; per-RX nullspace estimates inverse row gain, pseudoinverse recovers 2-element AoD response, then matches inferred sin(theta). This is a classical BGPC specialization, no new estimator claimed.
profile_scope: 35 alternating LS iterations per permutation; complex SVD initialization; reference receiver treated as a noisy regressor, not a full errors-in-variables maximum likelihood solver; same 3 probe measurements and same candidate permutations as invariant method
scope: synthetic separable point-scatterer amplitude model; compares an invariant, row-column ALS and known-array BGPC-AoD; no full errors-in-variables ML, TSP19 beam design or waveform optimization. Unknown nuisance gains sampled independently per receiver/illumination.
